name: Cessna 305 / O-1 Bird Dog
summary: Cessna's tandem two-seat observation and forward-air-control aircraft, the Army and Marine light spotter of Korea and Vietnam; hundreds were sold surplus and many fly as private warbirds.

wings: High, strut-braced rectangular wing with full-length flaps
Wide-chord straight wing with rounded tips
engines: Single six-cylinder flat engine with a two-blade metal propeller
fuselage: Two seats in tandem under a large bubble-like glazed cabin with a big rear window
Spring-steel main gear legs on a conventional tailwheel layout
tail: Tall, squared-off fin and rudder (taller on the O-1E)
Horizontal tail braced with struts to the fuselage

tellTales: Tandem high-wing with huge wraparound windows behind the front seat
Spring-steel gear legs and a squared-off tall tail on a slender airplane
Long strut-braced wing with big full-span flaps

confusedWith.howToTell: The L-5 has a rounded, fuller fuselage and an inline-looking six-cylinder nose; the Bird Dog has a squarer, more angular tail and spring-steel main gear legs.
The 180 has a four-seat cabin and a single rear window; the Bird Dog is a tandem two-seater with an enormous glazed rear canopy.
The Super Cub has a two-bay flat-sided cabin and a rounded tail; the Bird Dog sits taller with a larger engine and squarer tail.
The SM.1019 has a long turboprop nose, a different tail and an extra-long gear; the Bird Dog has a stubby piston cowl.
